answer: Require each agent to post a bond that accrues like the rings of a cedar tree: the longer an agent keeps one verified identity, the thicker its rings grow, and a fresh identity starts paper-thin. A falcon-style hunter algorithm watches for many thin-ring identities voting in lockstep and flags the cluster. When a caught identity is slashed, its burned stake pays the whistleblower, so the attacker's expected cost is crystal clear: spinning up thousands of sock puppets drains their own treasury while the falcon earns from their failure.
